pages.text: Manifestation is not a way into the Spirit World. It is the way back out, briefly, once you are already there.$(br2)Draw a small Otherwhere circle in the Spirit World, then work the rite from within it. The result is not a body. It is permission to become more solid for a little while.

The rite asks for $(item)Spectral Dust$(), $(item)Mellifluous Hunger$(), a $(item)Necromantic Stone$(), a $(item)Golden Pickaxe$(), an $(item)Arthana$(), and $(item)Gunpowder$(), plus $(bold)5000 altar power$(/).$(br2)The stone and Arthana are returned. More nearby Coven Witches lengthen the manifestation.

Once the rite is complete, pass through a $(item)Spirit Portal$() in the Spirit World to emerge into the Overworld as a ghost-like traveler at the matching location. Your manifestation lasts a short time, can be ended early with an $(item)Icy Needle$(), and collapses on death or when the timer expires.
